name: hideaway
title: Hideaway
description: Holiday cottages let by the week, shown as lit windows in a blue-black stone wall at night: each cottage's name is carved on a lintel over four lamp-amber panes holding price, status, rooms and area, which burn low when pending and go dark when booked.

tokens.--font-text: all text — an old-style book serif from the system, used upright, italic and in small caps
tokens.--text-s: small text: the address and note under a window, hours, dates, the footer
tokens.--text-m: body text and the status word in a window
tokens.--text-l: the site title, a window's lintel, the standfirst, the inquiry heading, the status word on a cottage's own page
tokens.--text-xl: the lintel on a cottage's own page, section headings in page text and the journal
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings, lintels and pane lettering
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of reading text
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the masthead, the page and the footer
tokens.--gutter: space between the page edge and the content
tokens.--gap: space between windows in the lane, down the page (across it is three quarters of this)
tokens.--bar: width of the white glazing bars between panes; the meeting rail is a little thicker
tokens.--margin: width of the dressed stone surround either side of a window
tokens.--depth: depth of the dark reveal between the stone surround and the sash
tokens.--pane-height: least height of one pane on the home page and the listings page
tokens.--color-bg: the wall: blue-black whinstone at night, grey harl by day
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, links and the lettering on lintels; also the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: addresses, the standfirst, hours, dates
tokens.--color-accent: lamp amber: the call button, the current menu item's underline, link underlines on hover
tokens.--color-accent-ink: text on the call button and the skip link
tokens.--color-stone: dressed stone: lintels, window surrounds and sills, the string courses under the masthead and over the footer, the inquiry box edge, blockquote and rule lines
tokens.--color-reveal: the deep shadow of the window reveal behind the sash, and the shadow line under each sill
tokens.--color-bar: the white-painted sash: glazing bars and the frame round photographs
tokens.--color-glow: lamplight spilling into the reveal of a lit window and round the call button (transparent by day)
tokens.--color-lit: a free window's pane at its edge — lamp amber at night, sky-pale by day; also a window with no status
tokens.--color-lit-core: the brightest middle of a free window's pane
tokens.--color-low: a pending window's pane at its edge (Under offer, Let agreed) — the lamp burning low at night, duller glass by day
tokens.--color-low-core: the brightest middle of a pending window's pane
tokens.--color-dark: a taken window's pane (Sold, Booked) — the glass gone dark
tokens.--color-pane-ink: lettering on lit and pending panes
tokens.--color-sheen: the faint reflection across a dark pane
tokens.--color-fleck: the grit of the wall: faint flecks of whinstone at night, of roughcast harl by day
tokens.--color-rule: thin lines: table rows and journal entries
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
